profile.headline: Engineer | Distributed systems, AI agent systems, developer platforms | webstatus.dev architect, Chromium contributor
profile.summary:
I architect developer-facing distributed systems, public APIs, and AI agent systems. I led the architecture and open-sourcing of webstatus.dev — a multi-region GCP service serving the global web standards community at 99.9% availability — and most recently shipped the Crash Report Context inspector to Chromium DevTools (M148).

Before Google, I built platform infrastructure at Microsoft, Capital One, and 18F (where I served as a GS-15 Innovation Specialist and authored Compliance Masonry, an open-source FedRAMP/FISMA compliance tool still in use across federal agencies).

Recent technical work spans:
• Distributed systems on GCP serving ~1M monthly API requests with strict SLOs
• Multi-phase AI systems for automated code migration, combining offline knowledge generation with retrieval-augmented generation at runtime
• Cross-stack contributions to Chromium browser internals (C++) and DevTools (TypeScript)
• Open-source platforms across web standards (webstatus.dev, Web Platform Tests), federal infrastructure (Compliance Masonry, cloud.gov), and the Cloud Foundry ecosystem
I'm most interested in building developer platforms, AI infrastructure, and the systems that make other engineers more productive.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Set technical and architectural vision for webstatus.dev, a multi-region distributed service on GCP (Cloud Run, Spanner, Datastore) written in Go, serving the global web platform community at 99.9% availability and 95% sub-1s latency SLOs. The Go backend serves ~1M monthly API requests and the frontend handles ~200K monthly requests, with a public OpenAPI specification for community and internal adoption. Drove open-sourcing through cross-functional alignment with Security, Legal, Privacy, and Open Source review.
- Designed and prototyped a multi-agent AI system using the Agent Development Kit (ADK) for web codebase modernization, employing a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) approach to inform code transformations.
- Architected and shipped the Crash Report Context inspector to Chromium DevTools (M148), spanning C++ browser-process backend changes and TypeScript DevTools frontend work. The Reporting API entry under DevTools' Application tab is now expandable, revealing a new Crash Report Context sub-page that lets site developers inspect the context keys and values configured on their Reporting API payloads — improving observability of crash and error reports for any site adopting the API.
- Contributed to the Chromium open source project, resolving a critical Origin Trials bug to enhance browser stability and re-enable higher token limits through a series of patches.
- Represented Google in the Web Platform Tests (WPT) open source project, facilitating monthly cross-vendor technical discussions with Mozilla, Apple, and other stakeholders to drive web standards and interoperability.
- Presented technical deep dives and lightning talks on webstatus.dev and web feature data strategies at multiple BlinkOn conferences.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · TypeScript · Distributed Systems · Docker · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Software Design · Python · C++ · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Google Agent Development Kit (ADK)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Introduced adoption of Terraform and Terraform Akamai provider module to manage CDN configuration as code to enable better deployment practices
- Led multiple internal and vendor teams for platform upgrades to the system responsible for authoring and hosting sites on www.microsoft.com
- Served as liaison between platform and compliance teams to triage GDPR compliance issues for pages on www.microsoft.com

positions.title: Master Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Removed a core blocker to enterprise cloud adoption by designing and shipping a service API that automated the provisioning of distributed compute workloads on AWS, accelerating the migration of on-premise services off the single-instance constraints of prior internal cloud offerings.
- Drove organization-wide adoption of Go through internal talks, hands-on workshops, and 1:1 mentorship, increasing developer productivity on cloud-native services.
- Mentored team members on Kubernetes best practices for production deployments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led a joint Capital One and AWS tiger team that prototyped and shipped new machine learning capabilities, expanding the bank's ML platform footprint and unblocking data science teams across the organization.
- Drove adoption of Continuous Integration by coaching other teams on how to build Jenkins pipelines.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led adoption of Kubernetes across all new projects, introducing Prometheus/Grafana, Sentry, and EFK (Elasticsearch-Fluentd-Kibana) for monitoring/alerting/logging; Packer and Terraform for repeatable VM provisioning; and Concourse CI for CI/CD.
- Reduced AWS compute spend by 10% through systematic infrastructure analysis and optimization, embedding cost accountability across the engineering organization.
- Built and maintained backend features for the Chelfie mobile app in close collaboration with the mobile team. Mentored junior developers on Git, Docker, CI/CD, Go, and TDD.
- Coordinated cross-team feature dependencies to build accurate release timelines that met management's requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Advocated the idea of “compliance-as-code” by building Compliance Masonry.  This tool moves teams away from manually generating the compliance documentation necessary to go live with an application. Instead, the tool makes the documentation testable and machine generated which allows teams to constantly deliver new value and keep their documentation in sync with those changes. Additionally, I co-hosted and co-organized the OpenControl Symposium for agencies and vendors where I demoed its functionality.

- Implemented an automated service to provision databases for cloud.gov PaaS tenants. This helped 1) reduce the number of 18F staff with direct access to Amazon Web Services to only 18F infrastructure which reduced security risks and 2) ensured consistency with database settings.

- Developed a web app to give cloud.gov PaaS tenants the ability to administer their applications. Prior to this app, users could only administer their applications via command line. The web app removed a barrier of adoption for users uncomfortable with the command line.

- Advocated for the adoption of the Go programming language. Presented internal talks about the language. Taught mini-workshops to explore the language. Provided one-on-one mentorship to teach the language. 

- Cloud Foundry Open Source Community Contributor.

- Encouraged discussion of diversity and inclusion by starting “Diversity Brown Bags” where external experts came in to talk about the topic.

- Facilitated the self-improvisation of 18F’s diversity and inclusion efforts by inviting experts to examine and provide actionable tasks.

- Created an internal survey to measure inclusivity among staff.

- Created diversity talking points and trained management to use those talking points to ensure engineers are talking about diversity and inclusion on Day 1.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Received Divisional Recognition Award for Delivery of Android Lollipop OS on Intel-enabled ASUS phones by working with international teams within Intel and ASUS by creating a solution that expedited OS installation which resulted in better user experience and higher throughput of devices from the warehouses.
Develop code features that 1) enhances Intel's stake in mobile and 2) enhances the Android ecosystem.
Develop enhancements to Android OS and submit code patches for submission and merging to Google's Android Open Source Project (AOSP) Gerrit.
Optimize Android Runtime (ART) to improve the user experience of Android on Intel platforms
